decision_conditions: The amendment to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application.
The following amendment is deemed to be accepted:
- Amendment to allow for a revised Energy Statement to amend the wording of condition 13 to:

The development shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and within 3 months (or other such period agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority) of the final completion of the development a post construction assessment shall be undertaken demonstrating compliance with the approved Energy Statement prepared by Elmstead Energy Assessments & Building Services, dated 23-10-2025 which thereafter shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for written approval .
Reason: To ensure the delivery of a sustainable development in accordance with the National Planning Policy Framework 2024 and policies GG65, SI 2 of The London Plan
The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the item detailed above and shown on drawing number and documents
-Energy Statement prepared by Elmstead Energy Assessments & Building Services, dated 23-10-2025
and not to any other deviation from the approved drawings
site_name: New City College, Ardleigh Green Road
description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission ref:P1697.24 dated 22/05/2025 to allow for a revised Energy Statement to vary condition 13 (Demolition of C Block, W Block, Nursery and The Space and partial demolition of A Block, refurbishment works including recladding of A Block, extended parapet, air source heat pumps and PVs at roof level, signage, widened pedestrian access from Ardleigh Green Road and hard and soft landscaping)
